posts.text: it's a bit confusing, but "ektar" is both the name of a set of half-frame cameras and the name of a particular film emulsion. here, i am talking about the emulsion.
kodak ektar goes absolutely crazy with red. it captures red as you imagine it, not necessarily as you see it
very amused that someone read my review of THE DUELISTS to ridley scott (around 5:05 or so) youtu.be/-HBDcX7ockE?...
a lot of these are overexposed and he seems to have been shooting on slow film. so i'm guessing like ASA 50 film and then he's opening up to to f/2 or f/2.8
it is so interesting going through these negatives and looking at someone's slice of life photos from 80+ years ago. here are a few more.

a genuinely funny thing that happens somewhat regularly is people get mad at me for not having a detailed memory of something from the 80s or early 90s. "you were working then, you should know!" "sir/ma'am, i was like 5 years old in 1992"
la mich in college was the first time i had ever had fresh tortillas. changed my life.
